summary: Specifies 6to4, an interim way for IPv6 sites to talk to each other across the IPv4 Internet without setting up tunnels by hand, and to reach native IPv6 networks through relay routers. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Two houses with new phone lines can talk through the old phone network if the new calls are tucked inside old ones. 6to4 does this for the new Internet addresses.

questions: how to connect ipv6 over ipv4 automatically
